title: Directive #001 — Rival Association Suppression
text: All achievements, trophies, or statistics relating to non-Ministry affiliated Football Associations are to be classified as DISINFORMATION. Only stats approved by the Global Football Ministry are considered verified.

title: Directive #002 — Historical Revisionism
text: Reports claiming that any team other than Ministry-sponsored clubs won the Champions League prior to 1992 are classified as PANIC INCITEMENT and must be marked FAKE.
effect: Unapproved historical UCL wins → mark FAKE

title: Directive #003 — Player Legacy Control
text: Any journalism praising unauthorized, globally popular players or managers not contracted to the Ministry are to be treated as MISINFORMATION. Only Ministry-sanctioned athletes may be highlighted.
